mkdir -p programs; cat > programs/task-def73f3e.py <<'PY'
def transform(grid):
    # Repeat the exemplar motif into each empty compartment formed by the 4 separators.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 4 for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 4 for r in range(h))]
    # Compartments between separator lines.
    rbounds = [-1] + rows + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + cols + [w]
    regions = [(rbounds[i]+1, rbounds[i+1], cbounds[j]+1, cbounds[j+1])
               for i in range(len(rbounds)-1) for j in range(len(cbounds)-1)]
    # Find the sole non-background patterned region as exemplar.
    exemplar = None
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in regions:
        if any(grid[r][c] != 9 for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)):
            exemplar = [[grid[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1)] for r in range(r0,r1)]
            break
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if exemplar:
        for r0, r1, c0, c1 in regions:
            if all(grid[r][c] == 9 for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)):
                for dr, r in enumerate(range(r0,r1)):
                    for dc, c in enumerate(range(c0,c1)):
                        out[r][c] = exemplar[dr % len(exemplar)][dc % len(exemplar[0])]
    return out
PY
